chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Abd al-Karim ibn Amr from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
"One does not have sexual intercourse with the young girl until she reaches nine years or ten years."
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum age for consummating marriage with a girl in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the minimum age for consummating marriage with a female minor, specifying that intercourse is not permissible until she reaches nine or ten years of age. It serves as a foundational text in Shia fiqh for determining the threshold of physical maturity (bulugh) for marital relations, distinguishing it from the general age of legal capacity. The narration highlights the practical application of maturity criteria within the family structure as understood in the Imami tradition.
